_about: The facts about one state that this code would otherwise carry in many places. A fork for another state edits this file; src/lib/state_settings.py reads it, and nothing else should repeat a fact that is here (preflight fails on a second county list). WHAT A FORK STILL CHANGES, beyond this file: (1) the General Court's page addresses, field labels and file formats in src/fetch/ and src/parse/, which are written against gc.nh.gov and its database; (2) the term arithmetic (term_of in src/lib/proceedings.py and a dozen copies of 'an odd year starts a term') and the Organization Day rule, which are computed in code and only described here; (3) the bill-kind lists, which three modules keep in their own orders (src/fetch/gc_web/fetch_legislation.py, src/pages/bill_order.py, src/parse/journal_bills.py); (4) the time zone as written in JavaScript (src/pages/app.js, live.js, workers/); (5) 'New Hampshire', 'General Court', 'RSA' and 'NH' in page text, the guides and the Learn pages, and the Spanish drafts; (6) district numbering, the county-and-district labels (Hills 22) and the 400 and 24 seat counts quoted in prose; (7) the Secretary of State, county and town sources under src/towns/ and src/ops/state_sources.py; (8) the logo, the domain in wrangler.toml and the email follow Workers.

term.note: The rule is computed in code; these are its parameters for a reader and a fork.

offices.name: House of Representatives
offices.source: seats and term from legislature and term above; Art. 9: not less than 375 or more than 400, biennially elected; Art. 11: floterial districts

offices.name: Senate
offices.source: seats and term from legislature and term above; Art. 25: twenty four members; Art. 26: single member districts

offices.name: Speaker of the House
offices.source: Art. 22: the House of Representatives shall choose their own Speaker

offices.name: Deputy Speaker of the House
offices.source: Art. 22: the House shall appoint their own officers; site/officers.json calls the office appointed

offices.name: Speaker Pro Tempore of the House
offices.source: Art. 22: the House shall appoint their own officers; site/officers.json calls the office appointed

offices.name: President of the Senate
offices.source: Art. 37: the senate shall appoint their president; Art. 49: the president of the senate shall act as governor when the office is vacant

offices.name: Governor
offices.source: Art. 42: the governor shall be chosen biennially in the month of November; Art. 49: who acts when the office is vacant

offices.name: Executive Council
offices.source: Art. 60: there shall be biennially elected, by ballot, five councilors; Art. 65: five districts

offices.name: Secretary of State
offices.source: Art. 67: chosen by joint ballot of the Senators and Representatives assembled in one room

offices.name: State Treasurer
offices.source: Art. 67: chosen by joint ballot of the Senators and Representatives assembled in one room

offices.name: Attorney General
offices.source: Art. 46: nominated and appointed by the governor and council

offices.name: Head of an executive department
offices.source: corrections/officials.json department_heads, which names each department and its head and not how the office is filled

offices.name: Justice of the Supreme Court
offices.source: Art. 46: all judicial officers nominated and appointed by the governor and council; Art. 73: during good behavior

offices.name: Justice of the Superior Court
offices.source: Art. 46: all judicial officers nominated and appointed by the governor and council; Art. 73: during good behavior

offices.name: County Commissioner
offices.source: corrections/officials.json county: each of the ten counties elects three county commissioners; no article of the Constitution names the office

offices.name: Sheriff
offices.source: Art. 71: sheriffs shall be elected by the inhabitants of the several towns, in the several counties

offices.name: County Attorney
offices.source: Art. 71: county attorneys shall be elected

offices.name: County Treasurer
offices.source: Art. 71: county treasurers shall be elected

offices.name: Register of Deeds
offices.source: Art. 71: registers of deeds shall be elected; Art. 72: a county may be divided into two districts for registering deeds

offices.name: Register of Probate
offices.source: Art. 71: registers of probate shall be elected

offices.name: United States House of Representatives
offices.source: corrections/officials.json us_house: two members, one from each congressional district; the office is the United States Constitution's

offices.name: United States Senate
offices.source: corrections/officials.json us_senate: two senators, elected by the whole state; the office is the United States Constitution's

2022.source: collected/sos_districts.json: the Secretary of State's 'Towns and Wards as Districted for Election Purposes 2022', which records/districts/*.txt are held to; its elections fill the terms from 2023-2024
